resources.string: This app uses Device Owner privileges to block system components and control access to other apps. There is a risk of "locking yourself out" and being unable to regain access to the blocked features. To prevent this, you must have a recovery code. This code can be generated below and should be saved in a secure location—preferably in physical form, on paper.
I confirm that I have saved the code
Needed to suspend apps and apply rules
Blocks adult sites across the whole phone
Shizuku is not installed. It is required to obtain owner privileges.
The app does not have permission to access Shizuku. Grant it to proceed.
There is already another app with owner privileges on this device. Only one app can have this privilege, confirm that you want to remove the privilege from the app below:
Almost done. To finish, tap the button below to grant device owner privileges.
Privileges granted. To remove them, tap the button below.
There can be no accounts on the device. Remove all accounts below:
Your device has more than one user. Duplicate apps can create hidden users. Backup and disable all users below:
Prohibit sharing screen content with assistant
Prohibit creating windows over other apps
Prohibit unknown sources for all users
The provider was reachable but didn\'t answer as a Private DNS server. Try another one.
Standard text field for entering the recovery code
4×4 grid that reshuffles after every tap to prevent position memorisation
Remove everything after 4 days, no code
If you have lost your recovery code, you can start a 4-day timer. After this period, you will be able to remove all restrictions. This process cannot be fast-forwarded.
I confirm that I want to remove the restrictions
Are you sure you want to cancel the forced removal process? The timer will be reset.
The 4-day period has passed. Do you want to remove all restrictions now?

When a focus session ends, the question can appear over your lock screen. Android 14 needs you to allow that once. Until then the question still shows on the notification, with its Yes and No buttons.
Always on. Automatic time and time zone are forced and the date and time settings can\'t be changed, so a window or a block can\'t be skipped by moving the clock
No schedules yet. Tap \"New schedule\" to create one.
Pick a starting point, add the few apps you need, then save. Nothing is applied until you do.
This schedule is locked until its window ends
System features turned off during the window
One per line, e.g. instagram.com. Applies to browsers that support managed restrictions (Chrome and most Chromium browsers).
While the window is open, this schedule can\'t be edited, disabled or deleted, not even with the recovery code. Forced removal still works after its 4-day wait.
Delete this schedule? Everything it is currently blocking will be released.
Select at least one app, service or website
Set a recovery code first. Device Owner can\'t be removed without one, except through Forced removal.
A locked schedule or a brick (focus block or urge lock) is running. Device Owner can only be removed after it ends, or through Forced removal.
Could not save this schedule. Nothing was changed; try again.
Locked schedules would cover the whole week with less than an hour free, so you could never change them. Shorten a locked window or turn off Lock while active.
While this window is open you won\'t be able to edit, disable or delete this schedule, not even with your recovery code. The only way out during the window is Forced removal, which takes 4 days.
A wait after the code, before changes unlock
Your code is right. Changes unlock in %1$s.
Turn the list below into the only apps allowed. Everything else is paused during the window.
System-level rules for the whole phone, like blocking factory reset or app installs.
Lets you switch on Android\'s built-in restrictions, which Déchaîner can enforce because it\'s the device owner.
Each switch is a real Android policy, so the phone itself refuses the action. No app can bypass it. Recommended ones are listed first.
Suspend any app with one switch, or give it a daily time limit.
The switch pauses an app right now: greyed out, unopenable, notifications hidden. Tap an app to set a daily limit; when the time is up it is paused until midnight.

Android itself suspends apps, because Déchaîner is the device owner. Limits use Android\'s own usage log, read only while the phone is awake, plus a non-wakeup alarm for the earliest moment a limit could run out: no service, no polling, no wake-ups from sleep. Needs Usage access once. Lifting a suspension takes your recovery code, and an app held by a schedule, a block or a limit stays held until it ends.
Settings for Déchaîner itself and its protections.
Private DNS, protections, entry challenge, recovery code, unlock delay, keyboard type and forced removal.

Anything that weakens protection goes through your recovery code, and through the unlock delay if you\'ve set one. Forced removal is the escape hatch: it lifts everything after a 4-day wait, without the code.
Weekly block windows, plus Study mode.

A schedule suspends chosen apps, system features and websites at set times every week. With \"allow only\" on, it flips around: only the apps you list work. Duplicate a schedule, or copy apps from another, so you don\'t pick them twice.

An exact alarm wakes Déchaîner at each window\'s start and end. Nothing polls in the background, so it costs almost no battery. Automatic time is always forced, so changing the clock can\'t skip a window. \"Lock while active\" makes a running window uneditable.
The permission that makes blocking real.
Makes Déchaîner the device owner, which lets it suspend apps, apply system restrictions, and stop itself from being uninstalled.
Granted once via ADB or Shizuku during setup. Android only allows one device owner at a time.
It won\'t be logged. Your count for this cycle stays.
Be honest. It\'s only for you.
A %1$d-minute session is waiting for your answer. Did you do the work?
The next focus session has started.
Finished focus sessions will show up here, by day.
Like blocking factory reset or safe mode
Adds that schedule\'s apps, services and websites to this one. Nothing here is removed.
Focus blocks: commit to a stretch of time, and your phone becomes a brick until it ends.

Sessions and breaks run by themselves until the end time. The phone stays pinned to this screen the whole time: only incoming calls, your alarm clock, Quick Settings (airplane mode, mobile data, hotspot) and any apps you allowed work; allowed apps open from this page. At the end of each focus stretch it asks whether you did the work.

Exact alarms run the timer with no battery cost. The pin and app suspension are Android device-owner features; if the app ever crashes, the pin releases itself and suspension keeps blocking. Once committed, a block can\'t be ended early, not even with your recovery code. Emergency calls always work.
Your %1$s (%2$d min) is ready. Start it when you are.
%1$s · %2$s. It\'s removed from the log and your totals. This can\'t be undone.
Tap the time to change it
A block can last up to 8 hours
None of these can be reached from this network: it may be blocking Private DNS (port 853). Try Wi-Fi or another SIM, or a NextDNS address under Custom.
Automatic DNS, nothing blocked. For when a network blocks Private DNS and your internet stops working.
This network can\'t reach that provider on port 853, which Private DNS needs: the network may be blocking it, or the server is too far away. Pick one with a ✓, or try Wi-Fi.

Your phone is bricked until then, breaks included: only this screen, incoming calls, your alarm clock, the Urge button and Quick Settings (airplane mode, mobile data, hotspot) work. Sessions and breaks run by themselves. The clock is locked. Pause is there for physical work: the phone stays bricked while paused, and the end time never moves.
Bricked until the end. No way out.
Once you commit, nothing ends this block early. Not Stop, not your recovery code. Only the end time.
How long this app can be used each day. When the time is up it is paused until midnight. Lowering it is free; raising or removing it takes your recovery code.
Needs Usage access, once: it lets Android tell Déchaîner how long each app was used.
Limit of %1$d min reached · back at midnight
These apps stay open during a block, with calls, your alarm clock and Quick Settings. Everything else is paused.
Tap the clock or swipe up for the menu
The urge lock ends by itself. Nothing can end it sooner.
Lock the phone for ten minutes and breathe until it passes.
Breathe for ten minutes. The phone cannot be locked until Device Owner is set up.
No lock. Write down what happened.

string-array.name: urge_breath_prompts
string-array.item: Let your shoulders drop. You only have to get through this minute.
Find where the urge sits in your body. Watch it, don’t fight it.
Urges rise, peak and pass. This one is already changing.
Breathe out slower than you breathe in.
Remember why you set this lock up when you were thinking clearly.
Name it quietly: this is an urge, not an instruction.
You don’t have to decide anything for the next few minutes.
Notice what your hands are doing. Let them rest.
The strongest part is usually behind you.
Almost there. Stay with the breath until the lock ends.

resources.string: Write it plainly, in your own words. Once your deep dive is made, this note is deleted from the phone.
What was happening just before the urge started?
How were you feeling, in a word or two?
Where were you, and roughly what time was it?
Your note was deleted from this phone. Only the deep dive is kept.
The deep dive is not made yet
Your note is still saved on this phone. It is deleted once the deep dive exists, or when you delete it.
No AI key is set. Add one under Settings, Urge and AI, and the deep dive is made then.
You have not agreed yet to send your note to the AI. You can agree under Settings, Urge and AI.
There is no connection right now. It will be tried again when the phone is online.
It is being made in the background.
The AI service refused the key. Check it under Settings, Urge and AI.
The AI account has no credit left.
The AI service does not know that model. Check it under Settings, Urge and AI.
The AI address is not a valid web address.
The AI address must start with https://, so that your key is never sent in the clear.
The AI service is busy. It will be tried again.
The connection failed. It will be tried again.
The AI service had a problem. It will be tried again.
The AI service sent nothing usable. It will be tried again.
The note and everything saved with it are removed from this phone.
What you wrote worries me. You do not have to carry this alone. Call or message someone you trust, or your local emergency number or a crisis line.
You have not saved anyone yet. You can add a person under Settings, Urge and AI.
Can you call me? I need someone right now.
Your reason, someone to call, and the AI behind your deep dives
One line, written on a calm day. It is shown while you breathe. It stays on this phone and is never sent to the AI.
Saved on this phone only and never sent to the AI. The crisis card offers to call or text this person.

What goes to the AI you choose: for an urge, your note and your answers, with a short summary of your last month (when earlier urges happened, and the earliest link and plan their deep dives found). The note is deleted from this phone once its deep dive exists. Your reason and the person to call never leave the phone. The key is kept encrypted on this phone. Without a key you still get three standard questions, and no deep dive.
A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it, or save an empty box to remove it.
This phone could not encrypt the key, so it was not saved.
Choose your provider above so your key is sent only there.
Use an https:// address. A plain http:// address would send your key in the clear.
That does not look like a web address. It should start with https://.
Without this, nothing leaves the phone.
Usual day or something special today?
Focus done. Did you do the work?
Focus time is over. Did you do the work?
Focus sessions and breaks, with a check-in after each session.
One continuous session with one question at the end.
With no answer in %1$s, this session runs as special.
Go outside or do something physical
Move. Air, water, a short walk. The phone stays locked, and the block ends when it ends.
Okay. The phone stays locked until your focus time ends. Your call.
The lock has ended. One question is left.
Let your shoulders drop. You only have to get through this minute.
Find where the tension sits in your body. Watch it, don\'t fight it.
Distraction rises, peaks and passes. This one is already changing.
Breathe out slower than you breathe in.
You don\'t have to decide anything for the next few minutes.
When the window opens, a focus block starts and locks the phone until the window ends. You choose usual or special when it starts. If you do not answer in 2 minutes it runs as special.
A focus window is at least 10 minutes long
A focus window is at most 8 hours long
The file holds your entries, sessions and goals. Entries still waiting for a deep dive keep their text in it. Keep it somewhere private.
The backup could not be saved.
Read the backup: %1$d added, %2$d left as they are or not taken.
That file could not be read, and nothing was changed.
That cannot be deleted while it is still in progress.
Removes what the rules allow: finished entries and sessions. It asks for the recovery code.
This cannot be undone. Your daily results are kept.
Wiped: %1$d removed, %2$d kept because the rules say so.
The end of a focus session, and the question that follows. The running timer is silent.
Optional. Without a key, urges get the three fixed questions and no deep dives.
Battery set to no restrictions (also turn Autostart on and lock the app in recents)
Pattern pad. Drag your finger across the dots.
You will draw it each time you open Déchaîner and its private pages: urges and deep dives. Make it different from your phone\'s lock.
Draw a pattern of at least 4 dots.
The two do not match. Start again.
That pattern could not be saved. Try again.
Enter your recovery code. The pattern is cleared and you draw a new one.
Ask for the opening pattern each time you open the app. Turning it off needs the recovery code.
Draw a new pattern. Needs the recovery code.
